en.e7bde9b1: This medicine is used for acute diarrhea and chronic diarrhea.
en.7c2bba2b: This medicine is used for acute diarrhea and chronic diarrhea.
en.4d8c1295: Adults with acute diarrhea take 2 capsules (4 mg), and as a maintenance dose take 1 capsule (2 mg) after each loose stool. The usual daily dose is 3 to 4 capsules (6 to 8 mg), and the maximum daily dose is 8 capsules (16 mg).
en.4b740c50: For acute diarrhea, adults take 2 capsules (4 mg) as the first dose, and as a maintenance dose take 1 capsule (2 mg) after each loose stool. The usual daily dose is 3 to 4 capsules (6 to 8 mg), and the maximum daily dose is 8 capsules (16 mg).
en.4cdc10d4: Adults with chronic diarrhea take an initial dose of 2 capsules (4 mg), then take 1 capsule (2 mg) after each loose stool until the diarrhea is controlled. After that, reduce the dose to fit each patient's individual needs. Once the optimal daily dose is determined, take it 1 time a day or divided into 2 times a day. The usual maintenance dose is 1 to 3 capsules (2 to 6 mg) per day, and the maximum daily dose is 8 capsules (16 mg).
en.52782030: For chronic diarrhea, adults take an initial dose of 2 capsules (4 mg), then take 1 capsule (2 mg) after each loose stool until the diarrhea is controlled. After that, reduce the dose to fit each patient's individual needs. Once the optimal daily dose is determined, take it 1 time a day or divided into 2 times a day. The usual maintenance dose is 1 to 3 capsules (2 to 6 mg) per day, and the maximum daily dose is 8 capsules (16 mg).

en.7c57218d: Children 9 to 12 years old take 1 capsule (2 mg) for acute diarrhea, and as a maintenance dose take 1 capsule (2 mg) after each loose stool. The maximum daily dose is 3 capsules (6 mg).
en.4021142c: Children take 1 capsule (2 mg) as the first dose, and as a maintenance dose take 1 capsule (2 mg) after each loose stool. The maximum daily dose is 3 capsules (6 mg).
en.9432d73a: Refer to the approved product information for details.
en.27f3ed86: Do not take this medicine if you are an infant under 24 years of age or a child (in the case of chronic diarrhea); have bacterial diarrhea with bloody stools and high fever, acute ulcerative colitis, or pseudomembranous colitis associated with broad-spectrum antibiotic use; must avoid slowing of bowel movement (peristalsis) because of the possible risk of serious complications including intestinal obstruction, megacolon, and toxic megacolon; have experienced hypersensitivity to this medicine; have hemorrhagic colitis; or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
en.741efd32: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it; are an infant under 2 years old; have bacterial diarrhea with bloody stools and high fever, acute ulcerative colitis, pseudomembranous colitis associated with broad-spectrum antibiotic use, intestinal obstruction, megacolon, toxic megacolon, or hemorrhagic colitis; or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
en.aace2623: Do not take this medicine if you are or have been hypersensitive to it; are an infant under 2 years old; have bacterial diarrhea with bloody stools and high fever, acute ulcerative colitis, pseudomembranous colitis associated with broad-spectrum antibiotic use, intestinal obstruction, megacolon, toxic megacolon, or hemorrhagic colitis; or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

en.4c46b6c8: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have liver disorders or AIDS, are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or are elderly.
en.d19dc649: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have liver disorders or AIDS, are pregnant or breastfeeding, are an infant or young child from 24 months to 7 years old, or are elderly.
en.1b4d8341: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking this medicine together with quinidine or ritonavir.
en.a8541b9b: Fatigue, dizziness, and drowsiness may occur after taking this medicine, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.
en.bf5d5dd7: Fluid and electrolyte loss may occur, so replace them with appropriate fluids and electrolytes.
en.b6bbfae7: For infants and young children from 24 months to 7 years old, stop giving this medicine if they do not pass a stool for 1 hour or more.
en.ee424e96: Infants and young children from 24 months to 7 years old must take this medicine only under the direction of a doctor or pharmacist.
